entities.summary: Kuduro is a type of music and dance born in Angola. It is characterized as uptempo, energetic, and danceable. Kuduro was developed in Luanda, Angola, in the late 1980s. Producers sampled traditional carnival music like soca and zouk béton from the Caribbean to Angola, house and techno playing from Europe. kuduro is a music genre, created circa 1999. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
